rationale: Every evidence-supported optimization that fits this workflow is already present. All seven jobs already declare timeout-minutes: 10 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: bound jobs with a custom timeout), so adding a timeout is redundant; lowering it to the 5 minutes in the experiment risks false timeouts on valid slow runs such as the PostgreSQL schema-load jobs, contravening the pattern's safety condition. Dependency caching is already configured via bundler-cache: true for Ruby gems and cache: yarn in actions/setup-node for Node/Yarn (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE), so no cache step is missing. Concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true is already set (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE). There are no matrix jobs for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, no schedule triggers for P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, and path filtering (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) is not safe because required_checks status is not_verified and shared configuration/generators could affect supposedly unrelated paths. No supported change remains that preserves coverage without introducing risk.
